description.skill: Instructions (SKILL.md), with optional scripts and files, that the AI loads when a task needs them.
description.agent: A sub-agent with its own prompt, allowed tools and model.
description.rule: Guidance that applies always, to matching files, when the AI decides, or on request.
description.command: A reusable prompt or slash command, with arguments.
description.output-style: Changes how the agent writes its answers.
description.hook: A command that runs on an AI tool's event, such as tool.after or session.start.
description.mcp-server: The connection to an MCP server: a program to start, or a URL.
description.permission-policy: Allow, ask or deny rules for tools and shell commands.
description.statusline: A script that prints the AI tool's status line.
description.lsp-server: A language server that gives the agent code intelligence.
description.bundle: A set of items installed together, as one.
